mapper.select: SELECT R.* FROM ( SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT RE.RECOMMENDED_EXERCISE_ID /* 추천운동아이디 */ , RE.EXERCISE_ID /* 운동아이디 */ , E.NAME AS EXERCISE_NAME /* 운동명 */ , CCD.DTL_CD_NM AS BODY_PART_NM /* 부위코드명 */ , E.IMAGE_FILE_ID /* 이미지파일아이디 */ , RE.SETS /* 권장 세트 수 */ , RE.WEIGHT /* 권장 중량 */ , RE.REPS /* 권장 횟수 */ , RE.DURATION_MIN /* 예상 소요 시간(분) */ , RE.SORT_NO /* 노출 순서 */ , CASE E.BODY_PART_CD WHEN '02' THEN 1 WHEN '06' THEN 1 WHEN '01' THEN 2 WHEN '05' THEN 2 WHEN '04' THEN 3 WHEN '07' THEN 3 WHEN '03' THEN 4 END AS GROUP_NO FROM RECOMMENDED_EXERCISE RE JOIN EXERCISES E ON E.EXERCISE_ID = RE.EXERCISE_ID LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE_DTL CCD ON CCD.COM_CD_ID = 'BODY_PART_CD' AND CCD.DTL_CD_ID = E.BODY_PART_CD ) T CROSS JOIN (SELECT TRUNC(DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE(1, 5)) AS PICKED_GROUP FROM DUAL) G WHERE T.GROUP_NO = G.PICKED_GROUP ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) R WHERE ROWNUM <= #{count, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY R.SORT_NO
